ios.desc:
Accomplish is for all the "want to-do's" in your life. Build your unique bucket list with everything from personal goals to places to visit. Anything you dream of can be added. Set your objectives, select inspiring images and add motivational pep talks to keep you going in the right direction.

Reminders can be added to help you remember and review your goals on a daily/weekly basis to keep the momentum going.

Everything you want to accomplish in life - in one place.
